name: Run two-person Google Meet
description: Create, join, admit, verify, and measure a two-account Google Meet.
triggers: If the browser is on a new tab, blank page, or any Google Meet page
actions: Remember the current tab as host.
Navigate to https://meet.google.com/new?authuser=0 and wait 3 seconds.
Store the current URL as meeting_url without its query string.
Open meeting_url with ?authuser=1 in a new tab named joiner and wait 3 seconds.
Click Ask to join or Join now.
Switch to host, open People, and click Admit.
Switch to joiner and require the waiting-room message to disappear and the Meeting details button to appear.
Switch to host and keep both participants connected for 30 seconds.
